item.text: The current implementation validates fields and handles simple cases, but it shallow-copies nested plain objects in one branch, so deeper sensitive fields can remain unredacted. I’m replacing that with a single recursive copy path while preserving non-plain object references.

Implemented in [src/redact-sensitive-fields.js](/srv/agent-workstation/workspaces/agent-prompt-research/phase2/runs/027-1-t06-redact-sensitive-fields-A/src/redact-sensitive-fields.js).

- Deeply copies plain objects and arrays.
- Redacts exact, case-sensitive configured keys without traversing values.
- Preserves primitives and non-plain objects by reference.
- Validates `fields` as an array of strings.
- Does not mutate input.
